name: NumberInput
summary: Stepper-flanked numeric input. Minus button + mono numeric value + plus button (and optional unit suffix) bonded inside a single field shell.

onChange.description: Fires on each step or keystroke.

step.description: Increment per stepper click and per ArrowUp/Down keystroke.

suffix.description: Trailing addon (unit chip): %, lb, STD, min.

keyboard: PageUp / PageDown — step by 10× when meaningful
Home — set to min; End — set to max
Type — overwrite value (clamps to min/max on blur)
rules: Native <input type=number> so AT announces role + value + min/max.
Stepper buttons get aria-label='Decrement'/'Increment' and aria-controls pointing at the input id.
Disable the minus button at min and the plus button at max — don't just no-op them.
Always paired with a visible label via Field, or with aria-label.

do: Use NumberInput for bounded quantity entry (cases, pallets, weight, count, %).
Pass suffix for the unit chip (%, lb, STD, min).
Set step to match the user's mental increment (5 for percentages, 0.5 for hours).
Default to mono tabular numerals so digits stay column-aligned across stacked NumberInputs.
dont: Don't ship without min / max if the domain is bounded.
Don't use NumberInput for money — currency-aware Input handles locale and cents.
Don't disable the stepper to communicate validity — disable only at the actual bound.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Single-shell stepper composition; mono tabular numerals; suffix addon slot.
